title: Archived Plant keeps grant identity while grant changes remain non-operative

given.plant: active Plant with an active Engineer grant

actions: Boss re-grants the same membership with plant_approve_actions=true while archived

then.identity: the same grant ID is retained
then.archived_effect: normal read, operate, task, and action approval stay denied before restore
then.restore_effect: the stored active grant becomes operative only after restore
then.safety: can_approve_actions is actor authority only and does not grant Safety Gate clearance
